clauses.statement: Unknown consumption attribution is represented as null and routes the next batch to VALIDATE; it is never converted to zero or a passing budget result.
clauses.rationale: Missing telemetry must not make an unmeasured batch appear cheap.

test_refs.case: unknown consumption routes to VALIDATE instead of zero or pass

clauses.statement: An adopted batch snapshot is immutable and unique by story ID and adopted commit, while current.json remains a replaceable compact projection.
clauses.rationale: A later HEAD or budget amendment must not rewrite the evidence used for the original next-batch decision.

test_refs.case: first snapshot is shadow, the next batch is enforced, and only improved outcomes advance baseline

clauses.statement: When structural growth reaches the configured threshold, adds a dependency cycle, or increases workflow-control surface count, Senior Judgment selects SIMPLIFY for the next batch.
clauses.rationale: This is the missing refactoring trigger identified by the repository retrospective.

test_refs.case: a new cycle or workflow control surface selects SIMPLIFY immediately

clauses.statement: VALUE permits every development intent, VALIDATE permits validation or simplification, and SIMPLIFY permits simplification; shadow reports mismatch and enforced mode blocks it.
clauses.rationale: The controller constrains purpose without serializing or disabling parallel execution.

test_refs.case: parallel usage is measured but admission constrains intent, not concurrency

clauses.statement: The public judgment CLI exposes status, immutable snapshot creation, and improved, unchanged, or regressed outcome receipt recording.
clauses.rationale: Operators need a small inspect-record loop instead of a new Gate DAG.

test_refs.case: first snapshot is shadow, the next batch is enforced, and only improved outcomes advance baseline

diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[Adopted batch] --> M[Measure once]
  M --> S[Immutable snapshot]
  S --> J[Senior Judgment]
  J --> N[Next batch admission]
  O[Outcome receipt] --> B[Baseline candidate]
  B --> M
diagrams.rationale: The only feedback edge crosses an adopted-batch boundary; an in-flight review is never stopped by budget measurement.
